column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_dodge.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module entry point of rel_dodge (scene 0x11). Sets the current thread attribute (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000)) and, when arg is 0, registers the scene with system_scene_register(start 0x00000054, end 0x00000110, data 0x00015500). Returns 0. Side effects: scene registration. No direct caller (module entry).

Scene start callback of the dodgeball mini-game. Runs the module constructor list (world_dodge_static_init), sets the thread attribute, hides the loading overlay, initialises the game (world_dodge_scene_init), registers frame callback 0x00000198 and leave callback 0x000001c4 with system_scene_set_frame_callback(2, ...), then loops world_dodge_scene_update + system_wait_frame until it reports completion; finally sets no-op callbacks, shows the loading overlay, waits one frame and leaves with system_scene_return(0x11, 0). The branch on world_dodge_scene_init's result uses whatever that void function leaves in v0 (hypothesis, confidence medium that it is always taken). No return value. Side effects: scene callbacks, loading overlay, scene change. Registered as the scene start callback by world_dodge_module_entry.

Reads the dodgeball parameter block (world_get_dodge_params, BOOT.BIN 0x08dc16c4) and calls the game set-up world_dodge_game_setup(block[0] character, block[1] variant (the player's team-mate in this game), -1, -1, -1, -1, block[6] light period / menu flag), then sets the draw-active flag 0x0001550c to 1. No return value. Side effects: global game state through world_dodge_game_setup, 0x0001550c. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_scene_start).

Runs one frame of the game state machine world_dodge_game_update; when it returns non-zero (game finished) clears the draw-active flag 0x0001550c. Returns true when the game is finished. Side effects: those of world_dodge_game_update, 0x0001550c. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_scene_start).

Same code as the rel_duel_draw function of this name; in rel_dodge it calls the game draw routine world_dodge_game_draw when the draw-active flag 0x0001550c is non-zero. No return value. Side effects: those of world_dodge_game_draw (display-list output). No direct caller (registered as the scene frame callback by world_dodge_scene_start).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x000030f8; nop) to world_dodge_game_shutdown. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of world_dodge_game_shutdown (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/world.md). No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

column2: void world_dodge_init_block_debris(int kind, int speed, void *debris, int u, int v)
column3: Initialises one 0x2c-byte debris particle of a grid block: +0x00 counter = -1 (inactive), +0x04/+0x08 atlas u/v, +0x14 = 0, +0x18 vertical offset = 0, +0x1c and +0x20 scale = 1.0f, +0x24 = kind, +0x28 = speed. Arguments come from the tables 0x00013ce0 (kind), 0x00013cd0 (speed) and 0x00013cb0 (u, v pairs), indexed by particle 0-3. No return value. Side effects: writes the particle. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_init_block).

When the particle counter (+0x00) is non-negative: increments it, adds world_dodge_scale_by_frames(speed +0x28) + 5 to the vertical offset (+0x18) and the constant at 0x00013cf4 to the scale (+0x1c); after the counter passes 4 it is set back to -1. Offset and scale are kept as float bits in int fields. No return value. Side effects: writes the particle. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_update_block).

column2: void *world_dodge_draw_block_debris(int *debris, void *list, int x, int y)
column3: When the particle is active (+0x00 >= 0) draws an 80x80 atlas cell at (u +0x04, v +0x08) scaled to size = scale (+0x1c) * 80, centred on x and raised by the offset (+0x18), through world_dodge_draw_world_sprite_impl (parallax 0, no flip). Returns the display-list pointer. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_draw_block).
Stores 0 in the particle counter, which starts its 4-frame run (-1 = inactive). No return value. Side effects: writes debris[0]. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_init_block, world_dodge_update_block).

column2: void world_dodge_init_block(void *block, int x, int y)
column3: Initialises one 0x150-byte grid block: +0x00 x, +0x04 y, +0x08 present, +0x0c breaking, +0x10 finished, +0x14 break frame counter, +0xc8 falling, +0xd0 fall count, +0xd4 fall frame counter all 0; four debris particles at +0x18 + k*0x2c (world_dodge_init_block_debris with the tables 0x00013ce0/0x00013cd0/0x00013cb0) and starts particle 0; allocates the work buffer of the break animation (layout resource 9 via world_dodge_get_resource) with world_dodge_heap_alloc into +0x140, initialises the ehf player and clears its 0x60-byte parameter block at +0xe0 (sets bit 16 of +0xec). No return value. Side effects: module heap allocation, writes the block. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_init).
Frees the break-animation work buffer at +0x140 (world_dodge_heap_free) if set and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: module heap release. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_free).

Per-frame update of a grid block unless finished (+0x10). While falling (+0xc8): counts frames (+0xd4), lowers y by world_dodge_scale_by_frames(constant 0x00013cf0) + 5 and lands at target row (+0xcc) * 30 + 42, clearing the falling flags. While breaking (+0x0c): advances the break counter (+0x14), restarts debris 1, 2 and 3 at counts 0, 3 and 6, projects the block position with world_dodge_world_to_screen into the ehf parameters (+0xf4/+0xf8) and steps the break ehf (+0xe0 frame) until its last frame, then sets finished. Always updates the four debris particles. No return value. Side effects: writes the block. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_update).

Draws a grid block unless finished: binds the texture of resource 1 (world_dodge_get_resource(1)); an intact present block is the atlas cell (0x16e, 0x15) of 0x34 x 0x26 at (x - 26, y + 15) through world_dodge_draw_world_sprite; a breaking block draws its four debris particles and then the break ehf (ui_ehf_draw with the parameters at +0xe0). Returns the display-list pointer. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_draw).

Starts the break of a block: projects its position to screen, seeks the break ehf to frame 0, stores the screen position in the ehf parameters (+0xf4/+0xf8), sets breaking (+0x0c) = 1, clears present (+0x08) and plays sound 0x7a98 (audio_dodge_play_sound mode 0). No return value. Side effects: writes the block, sound. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_ball_collide_grid).

Copies the block position (x +0x00, y +0x04) into out[0..1]. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 4 (world_dodge_grid_find_top_block, world_dodge_grid_apply_gravity, world_dodge_grid_get_block, world_dodge_grid_get_top_pos).

Builds the block rectangle from its position: out[0] top = y + 15, out[1] left = x - 26, out[2] bottom = top - 30, out[3] right = left + 52 (world y grows upwards). No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_get_top_rect).

Starts or extends the fall of a block: falling (+0xc8) = 1, fall count (+0xd0) += 1, target row (+0xcc) = (y - 27) / 30 - fall count, fall frame counter (+0xd4) = 0. No return value. Side effects: writes the block. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_apply_gravity).

Resets a fighter structure: character/variant/x/y/target/flags words cleared, state (+0x30) = 1, hit points (+0x40) = 5, +0x3c = 1, +0x48 = 1, timers +0x44/+0x4c/+0x50 = 0, active-action mask +0x214 = 0, the four action-ready flags +0x218..+0x224 = 1, the model words +0x1f0/+0x1f4 = 0, the three effect slots (0x80 bytes from +0x70: active flag +0x70, ehf work +0xe0) cleared, and the animation controller +0x1fc..+0x210 cleared. No return value. Side effects: writes the structure. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, the fighter vtable).

Frees the ehf work buffers of the three effect slots (+0xe0 + k*0x80) with world_dodge_heap_free and clears them, then calls world_dodge_anim_free on the animation controller (+0x1fc). No return value. Side effects: module heap release. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, the fighter vtable).

Per-frame fighter update. Ticks the animation controller (+0x1fc, world_dodge_anim_update), the frame counter +0x50 and the timer +0x4c (clears +0x44 when it runs out). When +0x3c is set it runs the state (+0x30): 1 standing: follows the top block of its column (+0x1c) in the grid (+0x228); no block -> state 6, animation 0, sound 0x7a96; 3 jump: advances t (+0x5c) by the constant 0x00013d70 along a Hermite curve (field_3d_eval_hermite_vec3) between the top blocks of columns +0x1c and +0x20, tangents scaled by the row difference, and on arrival copies target column/facing (+0x20/+0x28), state 1, sound 0x7a95; 4 hit shake: mirrors x around +0x18 for 10 frames, then stops animation 5 and returns to state 1; 5 knocked away: moves by velocity +0x60/+0x64, cycles the facing frame +0x2c 0-7, state 8 when off screen; 6: waits for animation 0 to end, then animation 3, state 7, sound 0x7a99; 7 falling: lowers y by world_dodge_scale_by_frames + 5 until below the screen, then hit points = 0, state 8, animation stopped. Finally projects x,y and advances the active effect-slot ehf animations, clearing a slot and +0x34 at its last frame. No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter, sounds (audio_dodge_play_sound). No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, the fighter vtable).
Returns word +0x0c of an animation controller (the elapsed frame count; hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_player_update).
Returns the animation id (anim[1]) of an animation controller, or -1 when it is inactive (anim[0] == 0). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_match_state_stun_anim, world_dodge_player_update).

Draws one fighter across three GE layers. Layer 4: the status parts world_dodge_draw_name_plate (side +0x08, character, variant, hit points <= 0 flag) and world_dodge_draw_hp_bar (side, hit points). Layer 2 (not in state 8): the animation controller sprite world_dodge_anim_draw at (x + 10, y + 0x32) and world_dodge_draw_overhead_hp. Layer 1: the character, world_dodge_player_draw_model path (world_dodge_player_draw_model) when world_character_has_field_model, else world_dodge_player_draw_sprite; a 40x40 atlas cell (200, 0) of resource 1 near the fighter while the stun counter +0x38 > 0 and hit points > 0 (mirrored by facing); the active effect-slot ehf animations; then the draw callbacks of the active actions (vtable +0x234 entries +0x28, +0x34, +0x40, +0x4c for mask bits 0-3). Returns the display-list pointer. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_human_draw, world_dodge_cpu_draw).

column2: void world_dodge_player_init(int *player, int character, int variant, int side, int team, int model_set, void *partner, int hit_points)
column3: Initialises a fighter: +0x00 character, +0x04 variant, +0x08 side, +0x0c team (0 player team, 1 enemy team; also selects the knock-away direction), +0x230 partner (the team-mate fighter), +0x40 hit points, +0x1f8 model set; +0x1f0/+0x1f4 = model slots 0 and 1 of that set (world_dodge_get_model_slot); allocates the ehf work buffers of the three effect slots (layout resource 9) from the module heap, initialises their players and clears their 0x60-byte parameter blocks. Arguments 5-8 travel in t0-t3. No return value. Side effects: module heap allocation, writes the fighter. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_cpu_init).
Stores the block grid pointer at +0x228 and arg at +0x22c. No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_setup).

column2: void world_dodge_player_place(void *player, int column, int facing)
column3: Sets current and target column (+0x1c/+0x20) and facing (+0x24/+0x28), then puts the fighter on the top block of the column: x = block x, y = block top + 42. No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_setup).

Returns the fighter position x (+0x10) and y (+0x14) through out_x and out_y. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 8 (world_dodge_draw_overhead_hp, world_dodge_match_state_move, world_dodge_match_check_hits, world_dodge_match_state_launch, ...).
Copies the fighter position (+0x10, +0x14) into out[0..1]. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 3 (world_dodge_match_state_move, world_dodge_cpu_aim_start, world_dodge_match_draw).

Returns the constant 30.0f (0x41f00000); used by world_dodge_match_check_hits in its hit test (hypothesis: the fighter hit radius, confidence medium). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_check_hits).

Subtracts damage from the hit points (+0x40). If some remain: when the stun counter +0x38 is 0 starts animation 9 (1 hit point left) or 5, stores x in +0x18 and enters state 4 (shake, counter +0x58 = 0). Otherwise clears the hit points and enters state 5 (knocked away): facing frame +0x2c = 6 (facing 0) or 2 (facing 1), velocity +0x60/+0x64 from the two-word vector at 0x0001476c (team 1) or 0x00014764, scaled by the float at 0x00013d64, sound 0x7a97. In both cases starts the first free effect slot (ehf seek to frame 0, screen position) and sets +0x34. No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter, sound. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_check_hits).

Same code as the rel_duel_draw function of this name: copies two words from src to dest and returns dest. In rel_dodge it copies two-word vectors (velocities, positions). Side effects: writes dest[0..1]. Callers: 3 (world_dodge_cpu_aim_start, world_dodge_player_take_hit, world_dodge_grid_get_top_pos).

Sets the stun counter +0x38 to 3 and starts animation 8 on the controller +0x1fc (world_dodge_anim_start). No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_check_hits).

Decrements the stun counter +0x38; when it reaches 0 starts animation 9 if exactly 1 hit point is left, otherwise stops the animation (world_dodge_anim_start with -1). No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_state_stunned).
Returns 1 when the fighter state (+0x30) is 5, 6 or 7 (knocked away or falling), else 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_check_hits).

Returns 1 when the fighter state (+0x30) is 3-7 or the hit-effect flag +0x34 is set, else 0. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_dodge_human_move_poll, world_dodge_match_state_item, world_dodge_match_state_check_end).
Sets bit index of the active-action mask +0x214. No return value. Side effects: writes +0x214. Callers: 4 (world_dodge_player_step_action0 .. world_dodge_player_step_action3).

Clears bit index of the active-action mask (world_dodge_player_clear_action_mask) and sets the ready flag +0x218 + index*4. No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter. Callers: 4 (world_dodge_player_step_action0 .. world_dodge_player_step_action3).

Clears the bits of mask in the active-action mask +0x214 and sets the ready flag +0x218 + k*4 for each of bits 0-3 present in mask. No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_player_end_action).
Returns the active-action mask +0x214 masked with bit index (non-zero when that action is running). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_player_draw).

Stores direction in the facing +0x24, enters state 3 (jump) with counters +0x50 and t +0x5c cleared, and sets the target column +0x20 to column - 1 (direction 1) or column + 1; plays sound 0x7a94. No return value. Side effects: writes the fighter, sound. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_cpu_move_poll, world_dodge_human_move_poll).

Returns the per-frame step of the angle and power gauges for the selected item: 4 -> 0x11, 3 -> 10, 2 or 1 -> 8, otherwise 5. The player argument is unused. No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_dodge_human_angle_poll, world_dodge_cpu_power_poll, world_dodge_human_power_poll, world_dodge_cpu_angle_poll).

column2: void world_dodge_draw_status_panel(int player, void *list, int item, int angle, int power)
column3: Commits list, selects GE layer 4 and draws the shot panel with the fighter's team (+0x0c): world_dodge_draw_angle_gauge (angle gauge), world_dodge_draw_power_gauge (power gauge), world_dodge_draw_item_icon and world_dodge_draw_item_name (item); commits the layer and selects layer 1. Argument 5 travels in t0. No return value. Side effects: display-list output, GE layer selection. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_human_draw, world_dodge_cpu_draw).

Drives action slot 0 through the fighter's handler table (+0x234): when its ready flag +0x218 is set it calls entry +0x20 (start), sets mask bit 0 and clears the ready flag, returning 0; otherwise it calls entry +0x24 (poll) and when that returns non-zero ends the action (world_dodge_player_end_action) and returns 1. Side effects: writes the fighter, those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_state_move).

Same as world_dodge_player_step_action0 for slot 1: ready flag +0x21c, handler entries +0x2c (start) and +0x30 (poll), mask bit 1. Returns 1 when the action ended this call, else 0. Side effects: writes the fighter, those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_state_item).

Same as world_dodge_player_step_action0 for slot 2: ready flag +0x220, handler entries +0x38 (start) and +0x3c (poll), mask bit 2. Returns 1 when the action ended this call, else 0. Side effects: writes the fighter, those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_state_angle).

Same as world_dodge_player_step_action0 for slot 3: ready flag +0x224, handler entries +0x44 (start) and +0x48 (poll), mask bit 3; when the action ends also sets the timer +0x4c to 30 frames. Returns 1 when the action ended this call, else 0. Side effects: writes the fighter, those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_state_power).

Draws the fighter as a 2D sprite through world_dodge_draw_character_sprite (model words +0x1f4 and +0x1f0) at the screen position of (x - 25.5, y + 27); the facing frame is +0x2c in state 5, else 2 (facing 1) or 6; walking animation frame (counter +0x50 / 2) % 6 in state 3 and +0x50 % 6 in state 6, none otherwise. No return value. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_player_draw).

Looks up the character's model bytes (world_get_character_model_ids(character, variant)) and draws it through world_dodge_draw_character_parts with the model slots +0x1f0/+0x1f4 at the screen position of (x - 25.5, y + 24), with the same facing and walking-frame rules as world_dodge_player_draw_sprite. Arguments 5-8 of world_dodge_draw_character_parts and beyond carry facing and frame. No return value. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_player_draw).

Writes the game's GE state into list: offset (0x710, 0x778), viewport centre 0x800 with 480 x 272, depth range 0xffff-0, blend func (0, 2, 3), scissor 480 x 272, alpha test (6, 0, 0xff), depth test func 7, front face 1, smooth shading, colour 0xffffffff, fog 50-100 colour 0x404040, clear colour 0xff000000 with depth/stencil 0 and clear flags 0x17, texture filter (1, 1), ambient 0xffffffff, lighting enabled with light 0 disabled. No return value. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_game_draw).

Initialises the block grid: 24 columns x 5 rows of 0x150-byte blocks (block index = column * 5 + row) with world_dodge_init_block at x = column * 52 + 26, y = row * 30 + 42; rolls a height 1-5 per column (world_dodge_roll_column_heights) and marks the lowest height blocks of each column present. No return value. Side effects: writes the grid, module heap allocations. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_create).
Stores present at +0x08 of a block. No return value. Side effects: writes the block. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_init).
Calls world_dodge_free_block on all 120 blocks of the grid. No return value. Side effects: module heap release. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_destroy).
Calls world_dodge_update_block on all 120 blocks, then world_dodge_grid_apply_gravity. No return value. Side effects: writes the grid. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_update).
Enables GE state 4, sets ambient colour 0xffffffff and draws all 120 blocks (world_dodge_draw_block). No return value. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_draw).

Returns the present block of the column (x == column * 52 + 26) with the largest y, i.e. the top of the stack, or 0 when the column is empty. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_grid_get_top_rect, world_dodge_grid_get_top_pos).
Returns the present flag +0x08 of a block. No side effects. Callers: 5 (world_dodge_grid_is_settled, world_dodge_grid_has_block, world_dodge_grid_find_top_block, world_dodge_grid_apply_gravity, ...).

column2: int world_dodge_grid_get_block(int grid, int column, int row)
column3: Returns the first present block whose x / 52 equals column and whose (y - 27) / 30 equals row, or 0. No side effects. Callers: 5 (world_dodge_ball_collide_grid, world_dodge_grid_has_block, world_dodge_cpu_move_start, world_dodge_human_move_poll, ...).

column2: int world_dodge_grid_has_block(int grid, int column, int row)
column3: Returns the present flag of world_dodge_grid_get_block(grid, column, row) (arguments passed through unchanged), or 0 when there is none. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_draw_minimap).

column2: void world_dodge_grid_get_top_pos(int *out, int grid, int column)
column3: Writes the position (x, y) of the column's top block into out[0..1], or the default two-word vector at 0x00014774 when the column is empty. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 3 (world_dodge_grid_get_top_row, world_dodge_player_place, world_dodge_player_update).

column2: void world_dodge_grid_get_top_rect(int *out, int grid, int column)
column3: Writes the rectangle (top, left, bottom, right; world_dodge_get_block_rect) of the column's top block into out[0..3], or the default four words at 0x0001477c when the column is empty. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_player_place, world_dodge_player_update).

Same code as the BOOT.BIN function of this name: copies four words from src to dst and returns dst. In rel_dodge it copies a block rectangle. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_get_top_rect).
Returns the row of the column's top block, (y - 27) / 30 from world_dodge_grid_get_top_pos. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_player_update).
Returns true when no present block of the 120 is falling (+0xc8) or breaking (+0x0c). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_state_flight).
Returns the breaking flag +0x0c of a block. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_is_settled).
Returns the falling flag +0xc8 of a block. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_grid_is_settled, world_dodge_grid_apply_gravity).

Writes 24 random column heights, system_rand_shifted() % 5 + 1 (1-5), into out. The grid argument is unused. No return value. Side effects: writes out, advances the random generator. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_init).

For every present, non-falling block above row 0 it checks the cells below in its column and, while one is empty, starts the fall of that block (world_dodge_start_block_fall) and of every present block above it (rows up to 4). The inner loop condition passes a hidden row argument to world_dodge_grid_get_block, so the exact test is read with confidence medium. No return value. Side effects: writes blocks. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_grid_update).

column2: void world_dodge_get_cell_rect(int *out, int column, int row)
column3: Writes the rectangle of grid cell (column, row): top = row * 30 + 57, left = column * 52, bottom = top - 30, right = left + 52. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_ball_collide_grid).
Clears the camera position and target words 0x00015510-0x0001551f. No return value. Side effects: writes those globals. Callers: 2 (world_dodge_game_setup, world_dodge_game_shutdown).

Moves the camera position (0x00015510, 0x00015514) towards the target (0x00015518, 0x0001551c) by the difference scaled with the float at 0x00013d78 (system_vfpu_vector3_scale). No return value. Side effects: writes the camera position. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_game_update).

Stores a clamped camera target: x in [0xf0, 0x3f0] (the 1248-pixel wide grid minus half a screen) into 0x00015518 and y limited to 0x80 below and 0x4eb above into 0x0001551c. No return value. Side effects: writes the target. Callers: 6 (world_dodge_match_state_move, world_dodge_match_state_turn_begin, world_dodge_match_state_flight, world_dodge_match_state_free_camera, ...).
Writes the camera target x (0x00015518) and y (0x0001551c) through the non-null pointers. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_state_free_camera).

column2: void world_dodge_camera_get_scroll_flags(int *out_up, int *out_down, int *out_left, int *out_right, int x, int y)
column3: Sets four flags telling whether a camera target (x, y) can still move: up when y + 101 < 0x550, down when y - 101 >= 0x1c, left when x - 240 >= 1, right when x + 240 < 0x4e0. Arguments 5-6 travel in t0-t1. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_match_draw).

column2: void world_dodge_world_to_screen(int *out_x, int *out_y, int x, int y, int parallax)
column3: Converts world coordinates to screen pixels: out_x = x - (cam_x - k * cam_x * parallax) + 240 and out_y = -(y - (cam_y - k * cam_y * parallax)) + 136, with the camera position 0x00015510/0x00015514 and k the float at 0x00013d74 (parallax 0 = plain scroll). No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 7 (world_dodge_draw_world_sprite_impl, world_dodge_player_draw_model, world_dodge_update_block, world_dodge_player_take_hit, ...).

column2: void world_dodge_game_setup(int character1, int variant1, int character2, int variant2, int character3, int variant3, int period)

Arguments 5-7 travel in t0-t2. No return value. Side effects: globals listed, audio, heap. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_scene_init).

Tears the game down: closes the result screen (0x0000db7c), runs the extension handlers of the bound mini_result archive 0x000156f4 if any, world_dodge_shutdown_stub, frees the match (world_dodge_match_destroy), resets the camera, destroys the module heap, releases audio tracks 0x2c8 and 0x2d1, terminates the 3D render state and clears the field_3d allocator. No return value. Side effects: frees all module resources. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_game_update).

One frame of the mini-game: increments the frame counter 0x000156e8, calls world_dodge_update_stub and world_dodge_camera_update, then dispatches on the state 0x00015520: 0 world_dodge_state_load_archive; 1 and 5 wait for a load callback; 2 world_dodge_state_start_title; 3 world_dodge_state_pick_enemies; 4 world_dodge_state_load_characters; 6 world_dodge_state_wait_title; 7 world_dodge_state_start_match; 8 world_dodge_state_run_match; 9 world_dodge_state_open_continue_dialog; 10 world_dodge_state_wait_continue_dialog; 0xb world_dodge_state_count_score; 0xc world_dodge_state_wait_fade; 0xd copies the score 0x00015540 to 0x000156f0 and opens the result screen 0x0000dae0(heap, mini_result archive 0x000156f4, 1, &0x000156f0), state 0xe; 0xe polls 0x0000e108: 3 closes it and goes to 0xf, 2 closes it, clears score and stage (0x00015540, 0x00015548) and restarts at state 2; 0xf world_dodge_game_shutdown. Returns 1 only after state 0xf, else 0. Side effects: the state globals and everything the state handlers do. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_scene_update).

Per-frame draw: GE layer 0 gets world_dodge_setup_ge_state; layer 1 the match scene world_dodge_match_draw in states 8-0xc; layer 4 the score panel world_dodge_draw_score_panel (score 0x00015540, stage 0x00015548) in states 6-0xc, the fade, the dialog ui_dodge_draw_dialog(0x0001554c) in state 10, the title ehf (world_dodge_draw_title) while the title flag 0x00015670 is set in states 2-8, the stage banner while 0x000156e4 is set (strTbl dictionary word 0xe formatted with stage + 1 by system_swprintf, drawn by world_dodge_draw_outlined_text at (0xaa, 0x78) scale 0x1e with alpha fading in over frames 0-15, held to 0x2d and fading out to 0x3c of the timer 0x000156e0) and the result screen 0x0000e46c in state 0xe. No return value. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_frame_if_active).

State 0: requests archive slot 0 (basic_lang_<lang>.ehp) with world_dodge_load_archive_slot and the callback world_dodge_on_resource_loaded (argument 0x00013dbc), then sets state 1 (wait). No return value. Side effects: file load, 0x00015520. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_game_update).

State 2: takes the title layout (resource 0xb) into 0x00015674, seeks it to frame 0 with play range 0-0xd, clears its parameter block 0x00015680 (0x60 bytes) and the frame counter 0x000156e8, sets the title flag 0x00015670, starts a white fade-out of 1 frame, sets state 3 and plays sound 0x7aa2. No return value. Side effects: globals listed, fade, sound. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_game_update).

State 3: calls 0x0000ef48(0x11, ...) twice with the player and opponent words (0x00015524/0x00015528) (world_dodge_pick_random_character) to choose the two enemy characters (the second call also excludes the first), stores them in slots 2 (0x0001552c/0x00015530) and 3 (0x00015534/0x00015538), frees the sprite buffers of slots 2 and 3, clears the load counter 0x0001553c, sets state 4 and clears the flag block 0x00015710 (ui_init_cutin_subtitle). No return value. Side effects: globals listed, heap release. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_game_update).

State 4: loads the sprite files of the next character slot (load counter 0x0001553c): slot 0 is character 1 variant 0 (the player), slot 1 the words 0x00015524/0x00015528, slots 2 and 3 the chosen enemies; slots 0 and 1 are skipped (counter + 1) when already loaded. Starts world_dodge_load_character_sprites with callback world_dodge_on_resource_loaded (argument 0x00013dc0) and sets state 5 (wait). No return value. Side effects: file loads, globals. Callers: 1 (world_dodge_game_update).

State 6: while the title flag is set waits until the title layout reaches frame 0xc and 60 frames have passed (then holds frame 0xd); then sets state 7, starts the title exit range 0x14-0x1c (or a black fade-in when the title is gone) with a 16-frame fade-in, frees any previous match (world_dodge_match_destroy), builds the match (world_dodge_match_create) and starts music track 0x19 with fade. With texture 0: the thin outer frame (0x3e, 0x3d, 0x165 x 0xa4), for the two sections the caption frames and value rows (frames of patterns 1, 3, 4) with the new-record icon 0xc where flag +0x44/+0x46 is set, the two total bars and rows, and a final frame of pattern 8 at y 0x100.
